date.description: UTC block timestamp of exploitTx; the documented time for rows without one

category.description: Root cause. Only code-bug rows feed the score curve. oracle-manipulation / economic-design / governance-design / insider-rug are measured boundary rows (they document why they are NOT code bugs). key-compromise / offchain-infra are a non-exhaustive context sample; they never feed the curve.

lossUsd.description: high-confidence USD loss (USD-pegged stables at 1:1); null when no such figure exists, in which case lossOther is required

lossOther.description: the loss in its reported non-USD units, e.g. "513,774 ETH permanently frozen"; the primary figure when lossUsd is null, useful context otherwise

victimContract.description: the contract containing the exploited flaw (the proxy, for proxied protocols); lowercase

exploitTx.description: onchain anchor: the attack transaction; its block timestamp is the incident time; lowercase

attacker.description: attack-tx sender (or documented attacker EOA); lowercase; used to check the victim is not attacker-deployed and to exclude attacker-caused upgrade events

documentedLastChange.description: for architectures emitting no standard upgrade event: the documented change date/tx the age is measured from

nonStandardUpgradeArchitecture.description: diamond/module-registry/beacon victims whose changes emit no EIP-1967 event; age may be overstated unless documentedLastChange pins it

independentFlaw.description: curve-dedup override: set true (with evidence in notes/sources) only when this incident exploited a DIFFERENT root-cause flaw than an earlier incident on the same (chain, victimContract, lastChange) key and was discovered independently of it; both then count as curve knots

status.description: OK = measured from onchain evidence. SCOPE_ONLY = context row with no measurable victim code (non-EVM, no pinned address, or category without a code victim); never a curve input. Rejected candidates live in exclusions.json, not here.

upgradeEventCount.description: pre-incident upgrade events on the victim, excluding events caused by the attacker (an attacker's own initialize/upgrade is part of the exploit, not a code change)

basis.description: deployment = immutable or never-upgraded victim, measured from creation; upgrade-events = measured from the last standard pre-incident upgrade event (count in upgradeEventCount); documented = non-standard architecture, measured from documentedLastChange
